name: Shader Upscale for Vestra Player
author: zysilm
punchline: Real-time AI upscaling of anime with Anime4K's mpv GLSL shaders
description: Sharpens and enlarges the video on the GPU while it plays, with Anime4K's neural-network shaders for mpv bundled in the plugin: six modes, Fast or HQ. Video ▸ Shader Upscaling… opens a window to choose the mode and quality, turn upscaling on and off, and see what is applied. Needs GPU rendering: macOS, or Windows with Video ▸ GPU Rendering (Experimental). Remembers your choice.
